title: Deleting an unused Part Library entry asks and confirms in Part Library words
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entry {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DELENTRY-01) has nothing behind it ("Total parts" 0), so it may be deleted.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the {Part-A} row.
  4. Click the edit icon beside the entry's name in the Part details panel.
  5. Click Delete.
  6. Read the confirmation question.
  7. Confirm the deletion.
  8. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  9. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 6: The confirmation asks "Are you sure you want to delete this library part?"
  • Step 7: The entry is deleted and a success message reads "Library part deleted successfully."
  • Step 9: {Part-A} is no longer listed.
